gaps.sentence: Did you remember ___ the window before we left?
gaps.explanation: 'Remember to do' = not forget an obligation; 'remember locking' recalls a past action.

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
He was made ___ for the damage to the rental car.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, 'be made to do' takes the to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.

gaps.sentence: On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.

gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: I can't stand ___ kept waiting when I have an appointment.
gaps.explanation: 'Can't stand' takes a gerund; the passive gerund is 'being kept'.

gaps.sentence: She left the room without ___ goodbye.
